Control_Description: Enforce MFA for all employees accessing company email cloud infrastructure and production systems.
Implementation_Evidence: Screenshot of SSO/IdP MFA enforcement policy

Control_Description: Review user permissions every 90 days to revoke access for terminated or role-changed staff.
Implementation_Evidence: Signed quarterly access review sign-off log

Control_Description: Restrict administrative and production database access strictly to authorized personnel.
Require at least one independent code review and approval before merging changes into production.
Implementation_Evidence: GitHub branch protection rules and PR audit logs

Control_Description: Encrypt all customer databases and file storage buckets using AES-256 encryption.
Enforce TLS 1.2 or higher for all external web traffic and API data transfers.
Automatically purge or anonymize personal data once the legal retention period expires.
Maintain and annually test a documented incident response plan including breach notification timelines.
Implementation_Evidence: Annual tabletop exercise report & IRP document

Control_Description: Assess third-party vendors for security posture and sign Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) before onboarding.
Implementation_Evidence: Completed vendor risk assessment & signed DPA

Control_Description: Perform automated encrypted daily backups of critical databases with quarterly restoration testing.
Implementation_Evidence: Backup job logs & quarterly restore test ticket
